basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gay male from Portland, Oregon. By day, I'm a freelance graphic designer, and by night, I explore Reddit for new ideas and inspiration. I love expressing my femininity through fashion and art, despite some family misunderstandings. In a committed relationship for 2 years, I spend my free time drawing, gaming, and discussing LGBTQ+ topics online. I typically browse Reddit during late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital art, having studied graphic design in college. Most of my expertise is self-taught through online courses and experimenting with tools like Krita. I'm also well-versed in LGBTQ+ issues, drawing from personal experience and community engagement.
